title: WHAT IF YOU ACTED
LIKE GTA 6 FOR 24 HOURS?

youtube.title: What If You Acted Like GTA 6 in Real Life for 24 Hours?
youtube.intro:
8 AM. You decide to live one full day by video game rules: never walk, take anything with wheels, eat to heal, hide until the stars fade. The first hour is amazing. Then real life starts keeping score.

Part of the series GTA in Real Life: five episodes about what happens when game logic meets the real world. Watch the whole series in the playlist.

This is a fan-made, original animation. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Which game rule would YOU break first? 👇 Never walk, take anything with wheels, eat to heal, or hide until the stars fade?

The facts check out: nobody can sprint all-out for much more than 10 seconds, a dog's nose has up to 300 million scent receptors (yours has about 6 million), and a police thermal camera sees body heat through bushes. Sources are in the description.

This is part of the series GTA in Real Life, and Mo already has the next idea: cheat codes.
